text.description_html:
Weslock 6661/6400, Single Cylinder Stanford Handleset

There is something to be said for traditional beauty; and the oval mounts of this Weslock made Stanford Single Cylinder Handleset paired with the delicate curved handle will not disappoint those looking for a classic that can withstand the ever changing fashions of today's world with undeniable elegance. Available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Easy to install, the Oval Stanford Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. There is an optional thick door kit that will accommodate doors with thicknesses from 2 inches to 2-1/4 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this Traditional Oval Stanford Single Cylinder Handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the lever operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

Also available matching:
Stanford Double Cylinder Handleset
Stanford Dummy Handleset

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Weslock Oval Stanford Single Cylinder Handleset:

  • Material: solid brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with 2-1/8" (1-5/8" optional) top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Elegance Collection Stanford Single Cylinder Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18-1/2"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 10-1/2"
  • Interior Width: 2-5/16"
  • Interior Projection: 2-5/16"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2" with optional thick door kit for doors 2" to 2-1/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
